note: A replayable bundle for the 20 April 2026 Wellington flooding. Real observations, generated reports and feeds, and an answer key held separately so triage can be scored rather than admired.
honesty: Every file below is marked real or generated. Every generated record carries a flag of its own as well.
The report stream is generated in full. No Council intake data is public, so there was nothing real to use.
Generated feed records are written into the real published schemas, read from the live services. The schemas are real; the records are not.
No real people. No names, phone numbers, or house numbers on evacuated streets. Streets and suburbs only.
Ground truth for this event comes from news reporting, not from a Council incident log. No such log is public. Times are approximate to the hour except the declaration, which was reported precisely.
This is not an operational emergency source. In an emergency, call 111.
